fields.v: Agent/harness Not stated for all. Study 1 Setup, 14-model schema (criterion stated by the authors: 'coverage and quality requirements', i.e. all schema models built with zero architectural violations): (a) Governed + agent n.s. + DeepSeek-Chat: completed, 5 min, OpenAPI lint 97, 0 violations, MI 78.50. Quality: works; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (b) Governed + n.s. + GPT-5-mini: completed, 2 min, lint 97, 0 violations, MI 78.26. Quality: works; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (c) Governed + n.s. + Kimi K2: completed, 7.9 min, lint 91, 0 violations, MI 77.30. Quality: works; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (d)-(f) Non-governed + n.s. + DeepSeek-Chat / GPT-5-mini / Kimi K2: all failed coverage and quality (typically 5-8 of 14 entities, no layer separation); per-model values Not stated. Quality: does not work; cost: not measured. Study 1, 118-model schema (governed only, same criterion): (g) DeepSeek-Chat: failed, context overflow (177K tokens vs 128K limit). Quality: does not work; cost: no criterion stated by the authors. (h) Kimi K2: 18/118, 0 violations, same MI. Quality: partly; cost: not measured. (i) GPT-5-mini: 10/118, 0 violations. Quality: partly; cost: not measured. Study 2 Extension (review feature, 1,936-line baseline; criterion stated only in the governed prompt: final submission must pass all architectural linting checks; none for non-governed): (j) Non-governed + Kimi K2: +244 lines vs governed, dMI -1.00, max complexity 13; code functioned, structure degraded. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not measured. (k) Governed + Kimi K2: base lines, dMI +2.10, max CC 4, 0 violations after linter feedback. Quality: works (passes all linting checks); cost: not measured. (l) Non-governed + DeepSeek-Chat: +834 lines vs governed, dMI -1.99, CC 13. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not measured. (m) Governed + DeepSeek-Chat: dMI +0.90, CC 4, 0 violations, fewest correction cycles. Quality: works (passes all linting checks); cost: not measured. (n) Non-governed + GPT-5-mini: +186 lines vs governed, dMI -1.43, CC 13. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not measured. (o) Governed + GPT-5-mini: dMI +1.04, CC 4, 0 violations. Quality: works (passes all linting checks); cost: not measured
fields.quote: Governed: The prompt explicitly referenced the deterministic toolchain and specified that the final submission must pass all architectural linting checks.
fields.where: §IV.B Study 2: Extension Phase, p. 4; results §IV.B.1, p. 5
fields.why: The governed Extension prompt states a pass condition (all architectural linting checks), which the text reports as met (zero violations), so 'no criterion stated' for the governed Extension entries is arguable.
fields.doubt: No Estudo 2, o prompt governado exige que a submissão final passe todas as verificações de linting arquitetural, e o texto diz que todas terminaram com zero violações. Isto pode contar como critério dos autores. Lê pág. 4-5 e decide se (k), (m), (o) passam a 'Quality: works' ou ficam sem critério.
